summary: Register Naver credentials through a one-time token, store them in macOS Keychain, and expose explicit login actions with safe progress reporting.

tasks.title: Add Keychain credential adapter
tasks.change: Implement safe security interactive writes, private reads, atomic owner-only account state, fixed failures, and tests.
tasks.effect: Worker can persist and retrieve credentials without placing the password in argv or output.

verification.risk_reason: Credential handling and filesystem state can expose secrets or corrupt account selection.
verification.test_reason: Existing tests do not cover Keychain argv, quoting, or account state protections.
verification.subject: Credential writes and reads preserve secret boundaries.
verification.procedure: Run targeted adapter tests with injected spawn and temporary state paths.
verification.pass_criterion: Only fixed security argv is used; failures are sanitized; state is atomic and 0600.

tasks.title: Add token authorized registration
tasks.target: Admin token, gateway route, worker save IPC
tasks.change: Add expiring single-use token CLI, protected admin form endpoint, and internal worker operation that saves credentials.
tasks.effect: Local operator can submit credentials once using a token and receive only a saved result.

verification.risk_reason: Unauthenticated network surfaces and credentials cross the gateway-worker boundary.
verification.test_reason: Existing gateway and IPC tests lack CSRF, single use, and secret response coverage.
verification.subject: Admin registration is origin-bound, rate-limited, and single-use.
verification.procedure: Run admin, gateway, and IPC unit tests with stub worker and token store.
verification.pass_criterion: Wrong origin, replay, expiry, malformed requests, and throttling fail without leaking submitted values.

tasks.title: Wire login credential actions and progress
tasks.change: Add fill, explicit submit, progress classification, secret masking, output projection, and isolated status probe policy.
tasks.effect: Login can be filled without submitting and progress reports only a closed status vocabulary.

verification.risk_reason: Password entry, browser action authorization, and authentication state are sensitive boundaries.
verification.test_reason: Existing login tests do not cover credential identity, submission separation, masking, and progress precedence.
verification.subject: Credential filling stays private and explicit, with stable progress classifications.
verification.procedure: Run affected login, runtime, worker, IPC, and MCP unit tests.
verification.pass_criterion: Password never appears in tool outputs or errors, submit is separate, and every fixture maps to the expected state.

tasks.title: Document operations and verify boundary tests
tasks.change: Document local token registration and agent login flow; add sanitized progress fixtures and complete targeted tests.
tasks.effect: Operators and agents have a documented, repeatable credential and login workflow.

verification.risk_reason: Documentation describes a security-sensitive operational process and relies on boundary tests.
verification.test_reason: Targeted tests from earlier steps cover the new paths and are required by the request.
verification.subject: Documented operation matches configured gateway and implemented flow.
verification.procedure: Run the requested affected Vitest files and inspect documentation against implementation.
verification.pass_criterion: All available targeted tests pass; the guide names the allowed origin, token flow, and explicit login sequence.
